title: SRE tactical lab notes and handoff — 2029-06-11
content:
Context: Weekly tactical lab for on-call rotation 2029-06-11. Goal was to run two short experiments against the serving runtime and validate a temporary mitigation for the tokenization spike we saw last week (INC-2029-1843). This doc is a mix of standup notes, incident summary, SLO snapshot, and runbook experiment results for handoff.

1) Quick summary of incidents since last handoff
- INC-2029-1843: tokenization CPU spike causing transient request queuing (2029-06-08 02:14 UTC -> 2029-06-08 02:43 UTC). Impact: increased p95 latency from 240ms -> 980ms on Hosted API region eu-west-1 for ~29 minutes, ~0.4% error increase. Root cause hypothesis: rare token sequence triggering multi-pass normalization in tokenizer lib v2.3 (patched library on path).
- INC-2029-1897: autoscaler mis-evaluated burst window (2029-06-10 15:03 UTC). Impact: delayed scale-up causing 5m tails for small private clusters. Associated with rollout of new scaling rule set (policy alpha).

2) SLO snapshot
- Global text-generation p99 latency (30d window): 1.1s, target 1.0s (on-watch).
- eu-west-1 p95 latency (7d): 480ms, target 350ms (degraded).
- Error rate (5xx) global 0.12%, target <0.1% (minor breach windows during incidents).
- Burn rate: sustained 1.8x during INC-1843 for 25 minutes.
Notes: We are not yet escalating to SEV, but SLO owners should expect a postmortem sketch in the next ASU.

3) Runbook experiments (lab section) — performed during quiet window 2029-06-11 09:00–11:30 UTC
- Experiment A: tokenizer fast-path opt-in (feature flag: token-fastpath:v1). Method: enabled on 10% canary for request routes with average seq_len < 256. Observations: CPU per-request decreased by ~18% for canary group; no functional regressions seen on 1k request sample. Failure modes: fragmented token stream for some non-utf8 inputs — we saw 4 failing requests (investigating).
- Experiment B: prefill cache TTL reduction from 60s -> 10s for private pools (config: prefill-ttl-experiment-6/11). Goal: reduce KV cache pressure in low-traffic clusters during bursty loads. Result: Burst latency improved by ~12% but cold-start token wall time increased marginally for very infrequent customers.
- Experiment C: autoscaler evaluation tweak (policy: scale-window=20s -> 10s). Simulated ramp using replayed traffic (shadow replay). Result: faster scale-up, but introduced oscillation when combined with aggressive pod termination. Revert recommended until HPA dampening fix is applied.

4) Actions taken in-response to incidents
- Tokenizer: rolled an emergency feature-flag disabling the multi-pass normalization path on eu-west-1 (flag set at 2029-06-08 03:05 UTC). Full rollback of library v2.3->v2.2 on the next maintenance window scheduled 2029-06-14.
- Autoscaler: temporarily widened burst window to avoid repeated flapping (policy patch rolled 2029-06-10 18:22 UTC). Follow-up: add unit tests for burst evaluation logic (ticket RUN-5420).

5) On-call handoff notes (for next rotation: 2029-06-12 -> 2029-06-18)
- Primary concerns: watch eu-west-1 p95 latency and tokenizer-related errors; keep token-fastpath flag toggled per vendor guidance (currently 10% canary).
- Runbook pointers: Tokenizer troubleshooting section (runbook v3.2) — see PR #67 for the latest diagnostic commands.
- Pager thresholds: lower the CPU spike threshold alert to 2.2x baseline for token-service so we catch early abnormalizations.
- Escalation path: for persistent p95 > 600ms for >30min, page oncall-sre-escalate channel and follow the stability run-deck.

6) Open hypotheses and experiments backlog
- H1: certain unicode emoji sequences cause fallback normalization — plan: add fuzzing harness for tokenizer inputs (owner: Lina). Ticket: RUN-5487.
- H2: prefix cache eviction policy interacts badly with low-traffic private clusters — plan: run longer 72h TTL comparison on a small private cluster (owner: Ravi). Ticket: RUN-5489.
- H3: autoscaler oscillation due to pod termination grace not honoring in-flight token cache flush — add grace handshake (owner: Ethan).

7) Action items (owners + estimate)
- Lina: fuzz harness prototype + initial corpus (3d).
- Ethan: HPA dampening patch and integration test (5d).
- Ravi: 72h TTL A/B experiment on private small cluster (4d).
- Maya: consolidate incident timeline for INC-2029-1843 and draft postmortem (2d).

8) Meeting/Standup notes snippet (2029-06-11 11:40 UTC)
- Quick sync: Ravi confirmed the private cluster TTL experiment will start Mon 2029-06-17.
- Lina: has a failing case from Experiment A, will open minimal repro and attach to RUN-5487.
- Ethan: will revert autoscaler tweak in staging and add simulation harness.

9) Misc/notes to self
- Keep an eye on the canary chart for token-fastpath over the next 72h; make a call at the next oncall sync whether to expand to 50%.
- Ask infra to reserve a quiet maintenance slot on 2029-06-14 03:00 UTC for library rollback.

Appendix: quick commands
- Diagnostic: curl -sS https://internal-api/eu-west-1/diag/tokenizer?sample=1 | jq .cpu_profile
- Canary toggle: ./ops/flagsctl set token-fastpath:v1 --percent=10 --team=sre
- Replay traffic: ./tools/shadow-replay --start=2029-06-08T01:50:00Z --end=2029-06-08T03:00:00Z --target=staging

Links referenced: RUN-5420 (autoscaler tests), RUN-5487 (tokenizer fuzzing), PR #67 runbooks, linear issues in linked_artifacts.

End of notes.
